purpose: Keep Heavyster calm, simple, global-ready, and monetization-disciplined while the product grows.
command: Show one calm path, one proof reason, one money rule, and one next action.
rule: Stillness wins: breathe, choose, act, then expand only if the action became easier.

focus_steps.name: One path
focus_steps.description: Start each buyer, supplier, or founder screen from the cleanest route instead of showing every module at once.

focus_steps.name: One proof
focus_steps.description: Show the trust reason before asking the user to make a decision.

focus_steps.name: One money rule
focus_steps.description: Keep phase one as active listing SaaS revenue, direct supplier payment, and 0% rental take.

focus_steps.name: One action
focus_steps.description: Make the next useful click obvious before any secondary option appears.

role_routes.proof: Verified machine, availability, supplier route, and copy-ready direct enquiry.
Profile, proof, availability, revenue, and lead route in one calm desk.
Demand, proof, supply gap, direct enquiry value, and listing ARR are visible.

ui_rule: Every release should reduce visible effort before it increases visible power.
global_rule: Every country should reuse the same calm buyer, supplier, and founder paths before local complexity is added.
monetization_rule: Free supplier profile, USD 9/month or USD 99/year per active listing, 0% rental take in phase one, optional 1% confirmed-booking success fee only after workflow proof.
ai_rule: AI appears only when it makes the next action easier by summarizing proof, drafting a message, routing a lead, or explaining the next step.

Copy focus brief explains buyer, supplier, founder, money, AI, global launch, and phase-one monetization rules.
